_comment: The P2 launch card's minutes per step (scripts/t61_card.py), each with its basis. 'measured' names the P1 session and step it was read from (L4, docs/spend_ledger.md); nothing here has run on an A100. 'estimate' is not measured anywhere. The compiled groups are not in: their ground truth is unresolved (adviser's ruling 2 of the tenth 9 Nov 2026 paste), and if they come in by 14 Nov 2026 their host time is added here and stated on the card.

setup_h.basis: estimate: write gate, deploy, preflight, bootstrap with XAttention (28 Oct 2026 card)

suite_record_min.basis: adviser's ruling 1h dated 10 Nov 2026: about 20 min. The L4 rehearsal's record took 9 min 41 s for the suite and the S8 run after it (attempt 1); the bootstrap bounds it at SUITE_RECORD_MIN, 25. First boot only: on Spot, block b1

teardown_h.basis: estimate: logs and manifests pull, delete, cleanup check (28 Oct 2026 card)

preflight.basis: estimate: the preflight with the one-cell Triton smoke check took 88.6 s on the A100 (P2 at lock-2026-11-13, 13 Nov 2026); the smoke check now runs every arm at 2048 through steps 7 and 8, the prediction's input and the ground truth's harness (the adviser's rulings dated 13 Nov 2026, item 3): about 25 s per step 7 cell (29 s each in their own processes on 13 Nov 2026, model load included), about 30 s per step 8 cell and 1 min for the harness, so about 5 minutes added

mask_gate.basis: estimate: each XAttention cell P1 banked, untimed, on two paths

ground_truth.basis: the hold, then measured: T3.2d step 9 (eager group, traced pass included), L4, then estimate: the Kineto export, then the worst case of 5 reruns at every cell (the adviser's ruling 2, fourth set of 12 Nov 2026): 5 extra rounds on 10, half of the 28 measured minutes, warm-ups and the traced pass included, so an upper bound
